scientific_queries.note: Sequential active-learning test on the locally held GDSC screen; no novelty claim.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the negative direction is unambiguous and the finite-pool caveat is stated as the main limit.

design.feedback: selected keys' true synergy is merged into the training set and the ridge is refitted each round

mechanism: signal depletion: the top-scoring candidates are consumed in the first rounds, so by round 5 exploitation falls below random (0.022 vs 0.024). The model is not degrading; the pool is.
finite_pool_caveat: the pool is fixed at 21,652 already-measured keys; real discovery has an effectively unbounded candidate space where this depletion would not appear the same way, so only the first-k concentration transfers
synthesis_with_R33: one-shot exploitation has real decision value (R33, 4.5x base rate); sequential feedback adds nothing and pure exploration never helps; the value sits in the first k picks

register_updates.C29: new, exploratory: sequential feedback does not change the answer; exploitation exhausts its own signal in a fixed pool

next_gates: a non-fixed pool or a much smaller k (5-10) would be needed to make the sequential test fair; both are outside this resource
